notes.title: Status update! (What's coming?)
notes.content:
Hey all! I'm sure some are concerned, because it's been a while since our last update. Short version: Vehicles are slowing us down! And I did not want to admit it!

Long version:
The game is very much alive! Features are being added constantly, but there has not been an update publicly released. Let me tell you all about what's going on:

1.Vehicles were finished and added, but there are no animations for getting into them. We didn't show what we currently have because in our opinion, it does not look release worthy yet. We are attempting to find someone to fill the animation gap, but that'll take time. We're all programmers and artists, but we have no full time animator. This is the biggest hold up right now.

2.The game is undergoing a mini overhaul so the menus will look better, and items in the world highlight as you look at them, I will actually have pictures (and video!) to share of this really soon.

3.We are changing the map up one last time, in the name of performance, so the game runs faster. This is the biggest complaint we receive about the game, and this will fix it.

4.NPC's are coming to the game in the form of citizens, and we want them to have several features before they are added in game, That way it feels more complete and less like a micro update.

5.Character customization and clothing is almost finished, so we wanted to add that in the next update, which is half of why it's been so long without an update (the other half being animations for the vehicle entry).

So, with all of that said, I could not come up with a good way to say "We're are just working on things", Which is why I've been quiet so long. Sorry about the silence!

Commercium is not dead, nowhere near it. It's still worked on, it just stopped being publicly worked on because back end upgrades don't make for good updates to show to you guys.

notes.title: Patch 0.2.0
notes.content:
It's finally time!
This update was about more structuring, and prepping for the cool things we plan to do, like fire propagation, pets and cars.

[h1] Patch 0.2.0[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Added bears! They can be found in the wild. Careful, they are hostile on sight, and quick to kill you. They have a little more polish to go through, but for now, they are quite entertaining.
    [*]Added reloading for all current weapons + animations for that
    [*]Added a world marker! They are somewhat tricky to get, but you can mark the world with them and use them to keep track of places. They can also be colored to change the name tag color
    [*]Changed loading system. All loading is done at level selection instead of game load! This makes the game open almost instantly! 
    [*]Changed a lot behind the scenes to boost performance even more. It's not buttery smooth looking across the whole universe, but it runs super smooth indoors!
	[*]Fixed a bug with the bucket list that allowed it to spam music to you
	[*]Added tab key function to close some menus
	[*]Fixed bug where sometimes hacking would not automatically start letting you type words
	[*]Added hotbar slots! You can now customize what is on the weapon wheel. It's now known as the hotbar wheel! You can use the number keys to activate them, and change them in the inventory.
	[*]Redesigned weapons to allow them to be removed and added to the hotbar.
	[*]Made ammunition an item, to be traded or given away.
	[*]Added fall damage. Careful on that rooftop.
	[*]Added a cedar tree, for a renewable source of wood. Plant it, wait, harvest.
	[*]Changed the bucket list to show percentages
	[*]Allowed aiming down sights with weapons.
[/list]

Next up, We're going to take a vote on vehicles or clothing options.

notes.title: Status update (Finally fixing performance good!)
notes.content:
It's been a while since I've updated everyone on the status of things, so I am fixing that!

We have a huge update planned, and I am going to fill you all in on what to expect soon:

 [list]
    [*]A breakthrough in performance was had! practically doubling the framerate of the game! You can expect to run at 60-90 FPS!* (With minimum hardware + shadows turned off. If you get a better GPU you can expect more!)
    [*]Deer as animals!
    [*]More furniture options + flags
    [*]Steam store features! Possible trading cards as well, depending on if they are finished in time for this update.
    [*]A goal in the game, with an unique "New game plus" Mechanic!
[/list]

The performance optimizations took weeks and weeks, but now we can safely go forward after this 0.1.9 update and focus on the game play and less on bugs and slow game speed on middle range hardware.

You can expect this update before this month is over.

notes.title: Patch 0.1.5
notes.content:
Back to the grind stone! We hope everyone had an awesome holiday, and look forward to the new year! :)

[h1]Patch 0.1.5[/h1]

[list]
    [*]Added the start to machines! Over the week, they will be tweaked to work better / easier. The power box, generator, smelter and mining machine can all be found in the crafting menu, and work near each other / rocks. To get supplies for them, punch rocks.
    [*]Performance improvements across the board! Indoors, you should see framerates of 68 to 120FPS, and a 20% improvement overall. Still a lot to do, but we're getting there.
    [*]Added Ores! Gold & Iron for now. Both can be sold as well, or smelted into bars.
[/list]

It's still not time to open the gifts yet. We're working on that one. :) Looks like it's going to be a new years gift!

notes.title: What Commercium is, and what it's going to be
notes.content:
Hello all, I felt that I should shedding some light on what Commercium is going to be, and what it currently is. This goes to all the people that wonder "What is this game?" but don't understand it completely yet. This will be a lengthy post, so if you don't want to read it, there will be a short version at the bottom. Thanks!

[h1]What is Commercium trying to be?[/h1]
We are aiming to make Commercium the sandbox game to beat all sandbox games. By that, we plan to have everything that should be in a modern sandbox game. Player customization, so that you can create your own player, Houses you build or buy, Vehicles to drive, Animals to tame & hunt, but we don't stop there. In the end, we want you to be able to mine for supplies to make your houses and things from nothing, living off the wilderness, automatic machines that do the farming/refining for you, Items to craft, Custom guns, tools and buildings, Farm crops to plant/grow, Houses to break into and steal from, banks to use, Animals to breed. We also plan for there to be a goal-based system, where you have to do all of these things to "finish" the game.


[h1]Why not put that on the store page?[/h1]
We do not want to mislead people by "advertising" features we do not have currently, and plan to update the store page as features are added. Commercium is only in it's second month on steam, and we plan to be finished by June/July, so we have a long way to go.

[h1]What is Commercium like Currently?[/h1]
Commercium is currently a decent house building game, with hints of the other features in. We believe if you want to build interesting houses, you can already do that. You can also sit in a chair and hold other players at gunpoint, and ride horses through town!

[h1]Short version?[/h1]
Commercium will be the sandbox to finish all sandbox games. We'll see to it. We plan to create something no one has seen before, and since you can currently jump a horse over another player, hop off your horse and watch YouTube on the in-game television, We're off to a unique start.

notes.title: Patch 0.1.3
notes.content:
It's finally patch time! We got a big one here:

[img]http://i998.photobucket.com/albums/af103/IcemanXChill/Presents_zpshkwahetz.png[/img]

[h1] Patch 0.1.3:[/h1]

[list]
    [*]Added Job Roles! You can be the Mayor, Police, Doctor or Detective
    [*]Mayor can charge people taxes, raising the price of all items in the game.
    [*]Police can handcuff players. No misbehaving!
    [*]Doctors can heal other players, and regenerate health on their own.
    [*]Detectives can tell who items belong to, and other helpful information.
    [*]All new jobs can be found at the new in game Jobs building
    [*]Voting for mayor occurs at city hall.
    [*]The pawn shop has arrived! It allows you to sell your things. You'll find it in another new building in both town maps.
    [*]Added a barrel to furniture. It's also practical, you can store things in it
    [*]Added presents to the game! Small, medium and large ones! You cannot open them yet... ;) We have one more update before the holiday!
    [*]Fixed a bug where your cursor would become stuck
    [*]Fixed a bug where some keys would not work properly
    [*]Fixed the day night cycle in multiplayer, it should sync properly now
    [*]Fixed the horse making jumping noises from miles away
    [*]Fixed a bug where land mines would not disappear
    [*]Fixed a bug where land mines could not be shot
    [*]Changed Bank time, so that it would accumulate interest a little slower.
    [*]Changed Horses to buck you off if they are hurt. No more free rides!
    [*]Fixed a bug with half walls not detecting furniture right. It was hard to hang pictures on them.
[/list]

We will try to get ONE more update in before the Holiday, and we wish you all a happy Holiday!

notes.title: Patch 0.1.1
notes.content:
[IMG]http://i998.photobucket.com/albums/af103/IcemanXChill/Valley_zpsq8mbsbnv.png[/IMG]

It's time! Patch 0.1.1 is here!

[h1] Patch 0.1.1	Notes:[/h1]

[list]

[b] What's new:[/b]
    [*]Added Horses! They can be found in the wilderness randomly, and you can ride them.
    [*]Added a HUGE new world. Going forward, everything will happen on this new map, This is our new home. It will be added to and changed as time goes on.
    [*]Added crafting! You can only craft a few items for now, but that will quickly change. Access it with the C key.
    [*]Added Iron ore, Gold ore, rocks and wooden logs! Components for things to come!
    [*]Added harvesting things by hand! Don't like a Tree? Punch it to death! It's all the rage in games these days!
    [*]Added stack able inventory items! You can stack things now!
    [*]The gun system is getting an overhaul, starting with the pistol! New graphics, new usage, new look!
    [*]New first person animations were added.
    [*]Day and night cycle was tweaked, you can now see better at night.
    [*]Performance enhancements across the board.
    [*]Added Chests to the game! You can buy or craft them.
    [*]Added Campfire! This can only be crafted, but it's toasty!
    [*]Added Sounds for many things!
    [*]Added damage effects, it's now MUCH easier to tell you're being attacked
    [*]Added a small message to tell you where you can and can't place things, and why.
    [*]Added a hardware benchmark! It automatically runs when you start the game to come up with the best settings for you.


[b] Fixes/Changes:[/b]
    [*]Redid the HUD so it has prettier icons now!
    [*]Changed the Loading screen to reflect the current game state.
    [*]Fixed an issue where chairs, beds and sofas did not work.
    [*]Fixed an issue where people would spawn in the ground.
    [*]Fixed inventories (Chests, Fridge, etc)
    [*]Fixed saving and loading of player ammo + weapons
    [*]Fixed issue where player would sometimes glitch when getting out of bed.
    [*]Fixed several UI bugs.
    [*]Adjusted view distance, it's now even higher. To compensate, you can turn view distance down further in settings.
[/list]

[h1]What's next?[/h1]
We will work on polishing what we have here, adding more furniture, food and crafting options. Then it's on to role play + jobs. We wanted Jobs to make it in to this update, but there was already so many changes going in, it would make more sense to polish this first.

notes.title: The skinny on 0.1.1
notes.content:
Hello all! 

0.1.1 will hit beta branch Tuesday the 6th, instead of the 5th as intended.n Slight change of plans..

Thank you all for sticking with us so far. 0.1.1 will change up the dynamic of the game a little bit. :)

notes.title: Patch 0.1.0
notes.content:
[IMG]http://i998.photobucket.com/albums/af103/IcemanXChill/Shoppic_zpsf1kp6jek.jpg[/IMG]


The update is now out on the beta branch! Those on the main branch will be getting it tomorrow evening, While beta branch gets 0.1.1. Double update duty!


[h1] Patch 0.1.0 Changes[/h1]

[list]
[*]Added option to game settings to disable/enable build mode entirely, allowing you to directly work with walls and floors. The new default is disabling build mode, you can enable the setting to restore the previous behavior.
[*]You can now hold E (The interact key) to bring up the context menu. Pressing the E key quickly still uses the item. This should make it easier for new players.
[*]Made the customizer even more pretty. UI WORK TO THE EXTREME! Bonus points if you can tell us what's different about the material selector.
[*]Added a Fir Tree! It can be found under decorative in the shop. This is the first of many items coming.
[*]Added Hunger! It'll show up in your stats menu from here on. If it goes down too low, you'll start taking damage. This can be disabled in world options when starting a game.
[*]Added Food! More things to eat will be updated during this week. You can eat items only from inventory right now. Later, we will add the option to eat food in the world, like at the table, for example. Great for roleplaying!
[*]Added Crops! You can plant your food instead of buying it now, if you want to live cheap. These crops can be found at the NEW Food & Farm Marketplace in the Commerceville, found by staying on the main road from spawn, across from the bank.
[*]Added a new loading screen! This will be updated and improved even further in the coming weeks.
[*]Added notifications to tell you when you're tired, when you're hungry, etc.
[*]Redid the furniture shop to be more attractive! Just look at that screenshot!
[*]Fixed an issue where the health bar would not change if you took damage. Speaking of which...
[*]Added effects for taking damage. You and everybody else will know when you're hurt!
[*]Fixed the ragdoll, it should be much more appealing to die now. We recommend testing it out, perfably on a friend?
[*]Added Orange berries! They make you move faster. I'd suggest farming those like crazy.
[*]Fixed sound effects on curtains and various objects.
[*]Overall polish added across the board.
[*]Fixed an inconsistancy in Comerceville's name.
[/list]

[h1] What's next?[/h1]

1.1 Highlights:
[list]
[*]Optimization, so the game runs smoother for everyone.
[*]Furniture! Anybody want an even more messy house!?
[*]More food options!
[/list]

Hope you all had a very awesome thanksgiving! :)

notes.title: Patch 0.0.9c
notes.content:
Once again, It's patch time! We've been set back a bit and a tad silent, but only because a huge update is coming and we've been working on framework for it!

Patch 0.0.9c will be the last minor update, then 0.1 is touching down!

[h1] Patch 0.0.9c [/h1]

[list]
    [*]Electronics now save on or off position when you save and load. Same goes for curtains and doors. Everything is now where you left it, how you left it.
    [*]Redid saving and loading to be much more robust on the back end, allowing us to save more complex things, and more effectively. 
    [*]Fixed an issue where people could move/arrange things that did not belong to them. This also fixed an issue where steal showed up when it should have read "Pick up".
   [*]Added framework for the next update. Not going to spoil it all. :)
[/list]

And a spoiler for what's to come:

[URL=http://s998.photobucket.com/user/IcemanXChill/media/HighresScreenshot00001_zpskshzmod7.png.html][IMG]http://i998.photobucket.com/albums/af103/IcemanXChill/HighresScreenshot00001_zpskshzmod7.png[/IMG][/URL]

This will be pushed to beta and the normal branch of Commercium. 
From here on, the beta branch will get the new updates, 1-2 days in advance of the normal branch, whilst we cover any minor bugs, and then it will be rotated to the normal branch.

notes.title: Patch 0.0.9b
notes.content:
Another update fresh off the press!

[h1] Patch 0.0.9b[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Added an option to disable world destruction for hosts.
    [*]Added a checkbox to the customizer that allows you to change multiple objects at once! we have more coming down the pipe to make things easier.
    [*]Fixed an issue with the saving system that allowed strangers to use each others things. We will work this back into the game with a sharing mechanic.
[*]Fixed several smaller issues.
[/list]

And finally, I have good news and bad news. The bad news is, all saves before this update will make you lose ownership of your houses, due to the code change. [b] We recommend you start a new save. [/b] We apologize for this, but the good news is that it should not happen again, because this new saving system is much more robust.

Next update will be looking at making the game easier to play without reading the help files.

notes.title: Patch 0.0.9a
notes.content:
Hello all, Another bugfix hot off the presses! Steam should notify everyone about it shortly.

[h1] Patch 0.0.9a[/h1]
[list]

[*]Fixed an issue where you would move if you tried to customize an object.  [*]Fixed an issue where the interaction menu would come up twice.
[/list]

That's all for now! Tomorrow we have another patch rolling out that will make customizing entire homes quicker! Build in bulk!

notes.title: Patch 0.0.9
notes.content:
Hey all! The first official patch is rolling out now. Surely this won't be the last bugfix update, but we're getting closer to actual content updates!

[h1] Patch 0.0.9	[/h1]

[list]
    [*]Added Toilets! Not functional yet, but very stylish.
    [*]Added a notification for players joining and leaving a server.
    [*]Added Option to open the shop anywhere by pressing M. This will have to be enabled at the hosting menu to take effect.

[*]Added an option to tweak save game settings, including name of game if hosted.

[*]Fixed issue where you could not host a game and then host another.
[*]Fixed issue where bank would occasionally lose funds.
[*]Fixed odd placement issues.
[*]Fixed typo errors.
[*]Fixed snapping on stairs of all types.
[/list]

Next update, we'll be looking at some potential quality of life improvements across the board.
